name: Density Grid Update with EMA
aliases: Density Grid Update with EMA — EMA Occupancy Grid Update
Taichi Dense Grid Evaluation & Occupancy Thresholding
definition: Updates the 3D density grid using an Exponential Moving Average (EMA) of newly queried densities to stabilize training.
summary: Density Grid Update with EMA periodically refreshes a 3D density grid using an Exponential Moving Average of neural network predictions to stabilize training and generate a binary occupancy map for ray-marching acceleration.
